name: VL53L1X laser distance (ToF, long range)
description: Like the VL53L0X but reaches about 4 m. Shares the I²C wires with the OLED. It has the same I²C address as the VL53L0X, so fit one or the other. Peel off the protective film.

options.label: Also count as presence when something is closer than (mm, 0 = off)
